source.description: Reviewed handmade raster graphite and restrained colored-pencil process contact sheet.
source.notes: One centered erupting volcano landscape; no labels, arrows, numbers, UI, signatures, watermarks, people, buildings, or decorative border.

process_strategy: Eight cumulative panels lock the mountain, crater, plume, lava routes, ground ridges, and ejected rocks before value or color, then reserve the final panel for reinforcement only.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one center axis, one wide triangular mountain envelope, one crater ellipse, one rising plume spine, two lava routes, and two ground arcs.

anchor_map.early_mark: One wide triangular mountain envelope crossed by a shallow crater ellipse
anchor_map.becomes: The volcanic cone and open crater rim
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The crater remains centered on the cone peak and the two mountain shoulders descend to the same ground anchors.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale envelope and ellipse only in Panel 1; the broken rock silhouette begins in Panel 2.

anchor_map.early_mark: One vertical plume spine with three widening oval guides
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The plume rises from the crater center and widens upward without shifting sideways.
anchor_map.construction_note: Open pale guides only until cloud lobes are established in Panel 3.

anchor_map.early_mark: Two descending lava routes and two low ground arcs
anchor_map.becomes: Two restrained lava streams and foreground rock ridges
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: Both lava routes begin inside the crater and stop at the same lower cone anchors; the ground arcs remain behind the cone base.
anchor_map.construction_note: Single pale routes only in Panel 1; no finished lava banks or ground texture.

final_elements.name: volcano crater plume lava and ground construction guides
final_elements.description: One mountain envelope, centered crater ellipse, vertical plume spine, three plume ovals, two lava routes, and two ground arcs.

final_elements.name: broken volcanic cone silhouette and reserved vent rim
final_elements.description: A broad rocky cone with two uneven shoulders and two short side-rim keeper arcs that leave the central plume footprint open.

final_elements.name: stacked eruption plume and two ground ridges
final_elements.description: A three-tier ash plume attached to the crater and two low landscape ridges behind the cone.

final_elements.name: two lava streams and five ejected rocks
final_elements.description: Two narrow lava streams following the planned routes and exactly five small rocks arcing beside the plume.

final_elements.name: rock planes plume curls and shadow footprint
final_elements.description: Sparse angular rock planes, inner smoke curls, crater lip hatching, and one broken ground-shadow footprint.

final_elements.name: graphite value and restrained lava color map
final_elements.description: Directional graphite, warm gray ash, muted rust-red lava banks, orange-yellow lava cores, and cool-gray ground shadow.

final_elements.name: ash depth lava glow and rock-edge accents
final_elements.description: Small established ash shadows, lava-edge contrast, rock hatching, and open-paper highlights.

overlap_reservations.foreground_element: broken volcanic cone silhouette and reserved vent rim
overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: Ground-ridge keeper lines stop at the reserved cone silhouette, and the plume begins only at the open crater rather than passing through its rim.

overlap_reservations.foreground_element: stacked eruption plume and two ground ridges
overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The two crater-rim keeper arcs stop on either side of the reserved central vent gap, so the Step 3 plume occupies blank paper rather than covering finished crater work.

final_step.visible_job: Only strengthen established keeper contours, deepen mapped graphite and restrained color, and clarify the same plume, lava, rocks, highlights, and shadow.
allowed_changes: small established texture and highlight clarification

rejection_checks: Reject a detailed first panel, drifting crater or plume, or mountain shoulders that change width.
Reject any sequence that changes the two lava routes or exactly five ejected rocks after they appear.
Reject a final that introduces plume tiers, lava, rocks, landscape contours, texture regions, color regions, buildings, people, or extra props absent earlier.
Reject vector-like linework, glossy poster rendering, repeated darkened tracings, labels, arrows, text, signatures, or watermarks.
